marco.docs: quick flag from a new hire walkthrough 70% of the onboarding checklist failed due to a 404 on the runtime guide -> kv-cache anchor.
liz.oncall: thanks for catching this. which anchor specifically? link I saw was /kb/kv-cache#prefetch-behavior
marco.docs: yeah that one. looks like the kb page was reheadinged last month and the old anchor disappeared.
sam.devex: ugh. recurring pattern. We should probably add a tiny note in docs-maintainers about keeping legacy anchors or adding HTML alias anchors when renaming headings. Saves developers time. :100:
marco.docs: low-effort fix: add an HTML anchor with the old id right above the new heading, and update the runtime guide link to point to the canonical new heading. I'll do a quick PR.
liz.oncall: please run the preview link-checker so we don't merge another broken link. The preview job can run the same check as main.
marco.docs: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4893 

Patch summary:
- add redundant HTML anchor `<!-- anchor: prefetch-behavior -->` above new heading
- update runtime/guide link to the canonical new heading
- add one-line comment explaining why alias exists

Command I used for local check: `./ci/link-check --branch-preview`
ops-bot: link-check job started for PR 4893
ci-bot: link-check completed  all checks passed (1 alias anchor warning)
liz.oncall: code review: left a tiny nit to use an HTML comment format that survives mdx processing. otherwise LGTM.
marco.docs: updated per review, moved comment into an HTML comment block and kept the alias anchor.
sam.devex: thanks! follow-up: can someone add a one-paragraph note to docs-maintainers.md under "Changing headings" recommending adding alias anchors and running the preview link-checker? I can draft it if nobody has bandwidth.
liz.oncall: I can add it later today. I'll include an example snippet and the command to run the checker in PR template.
marco.docs: perfect. scheduling merge for tomorrow morning deploy window to avoid staging noise.
ops-bot: merge scheduled by marco.docs for 2024-04-18 09:30 UTC
marco.docs: closing loop: extra thanks to the CI team for the preview link checker; that caught the regression before prod. :relieved:
